artists.biography: Held By Trees is an instrumental post-rock collaboration of musicians from the United Kingdom. The music is heavily inspired by Talk Talk and Mark Hollis. Many musicians that took part in the infamous sessions for Talk Talk's Spirit of Eden (1988) and Laughing Stock (1991), as well as Mark Hollis' solo album (1998), collaborated on Held By Trees' début LP, Solace (2022). Other inspirations include the minimal piano work of Ryuichi Sakamoto and early 1970s Pink Floyd. Read more on Last.fm. Held By Trees.biography: Held By Trees is an instrumental post-rock collaboration of musicians from the United Kingdom. The music is heavily inspired by Talk Talk and Mark Hollis. Many musicians that took part in the infamous sessions for Talk Talk's Spirit of Eden (1988) and Laughing Stock (1991), as well as Mark Hollis' solo album (1998), collaborated on Held By Trees' début LP, Solace (2022). Other inspirations include the minimal piano work of Ryuichi Sakamoto and early 1970s Pink Floyd. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Solace is the debut album by Held By Trees, released in April 2022 on the Tweed Jacket Music Ltd. label. The album blends rock with ambient and pastoral influences, drawing heavy inspiration from Talk Talk and Mark Hollis. It features contributions from notable musicians associated with Pink Floyd, Dire Straits, Blur, Wire, and others, creating a richly textured sound that balances atmospheric ambience with intricate musicianship.

Positioned as the foundational work in Held By Trees' discography, Solace established the collective's signature style of contemplative, instrumental-driven music. The album charted on the UK indie and physical sales charts, receiving global critical acclaim for its unique fusion of rock and ambient elements and its evocative, spacious arrangements. This debut set the stage for subsequent releases, including the more ambient and heavier follow-up Hinterland (2025), further exploring the group's evolving sound palette.
